get.description: List Wbs Attributes items for a given project

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[attribute_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Attribute IDs.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to sort by. If the field is passed with a - (Example: -name) it is sorted in reverse order. For multiple sort fields, separate  them with a comma (Example: name,-position)

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

items.description: A work breakdown structure attribute item.

attribute_id.description: String ID of the parent WBS Attribute this item belongs to. Use to group items by attribute or to filter the list endpoint with filters[attribute_id]. Retrieve valid attribute IDs from GET /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/wbs/attributes.

id.description: Unique string identifier for this WBS Attribute Item. Use as the {wbs_attribute_item_id} path parameter in PATCH/DELETE /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/wbs/attribute_items/{wbs_attribute_item_id}.

name.description: Display name of this attribute item. Must be unique within its parent attribute (e.g. "Labor", "Materials"). Shown in WBS code pickers and budget views.

reason_code.description: A machine-readable code that identifies the error specifically enough for the client to interpret what happened and take action.
